critical.title: ⚡ STRUCTURAL — BTC breaks the 200-week MA, tags $62,000 on a >$2B liquidation flush
critical.text: BTC briefly touched $62,000 on Saturday (down more than 8% intraday) and has recovered to $65,449. More than $2B of leveraged positions across 320,000+ traders were liquidated in 24 hours, spot ETFs logged seven straight outflow sessions (~$1.91B) through 11/13, and markets fully price a December Fed hike. Fear & Greed [→ Glossary] fell to 13. Fogle 🔴 and Macro 🔴 stay bearish; Wright stays 🟡 as sentiment washes out. Does not change the composite (NEUTRAL, LOW) but is a new low for this leg of the decline.
